5 Days Gorilla Trekking & Lake Bunyonyi

Book This Tour

Overview

An exceptional 5-day Uganda safari combining the world's greatest wildlife encounter — mountain gorilla trekking in Bwindi — with a relaxing finale on the stunning terraced shores of Lake Bunyonyi, Africa's second deepest lake.

Tour Highlights

Mountain gorilla trekking in Bwindi Impenetrable Forest
Relaxing stay on the shores of Lake Bunyonyi
Canoe exploration of Bunyonyi's 29 islands
Batwa cultural experience and forest walk
Scenic drive through Uganda's beautiful southwest

Day-by-Day Itinerary

D1 Kampala – Bwindi

Scenic 8-hour drive through Uganda's rolling hills, stopping at the equator and in Kabale town. Arrive Bwindi for dinner and overnight at forest lodge.

D2 Gorilla Trekking in Bwindi

The main event — trek into Bwindi's ancient primeval forest guided by expert trackers to find your assigned gorilla family. One hour of pure magic face-to-face with mountain gorillas. Afternoon rest and debrief.

D3 Batwa Cultural Experience

Morning: guided half-day experience with the Batwa people, the original 'keepers' of the Bwindi Forest. Learn traditional forest survival skills, music, and storytelling. Afternoon drive to Lake Bunyonyi.

D4 Lake Bunyonyi – Island Exploration

Full relaxing day on Africa's second deepest lake. Canoe between Bunyonyi's 29 islands. Visit Punishment Island with its remarkable history. Sunset from the lakeside terrace.

D5 Lake Bunyonyi – Kampala

Morning canoe sunrise paddle. After breakfast, scenic drive back to Kampala arriving in the late afternoon. End of an unforgettable 5-day Uganda adventure.
